title: Negation of a product character
statement: Let $m$ be a positive natural number, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\alpha\colon\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z$. The product character indexed by $-\alpha$ is the pointwise inverse of the product character indexed by $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: $\alpha$ is a function from $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ to $\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z$
